form:FormGroup.label: Editor Theme
form:FormGroup.helpText: The colour theme for code editors. The themes offered match the Light or Dark Stroom theme, and changing the Stroom theme resets this to its default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Themes offered match the Light or Dark Stroom theme.

form:FormGroup.label: Editor Key Bindings
form:FormGroup.helpText: The keyboard shortcuts used in code editors: Standard or Vim. Default is Standard unless an administrator has changed the defaults.

form:FormGroup.label: Editor Live Auto Completion
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether code editors show completion suggestions automatically as you type. Default is Off unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Shows suggestions as you type. Default is Off.

form:FormGroup.label: Text Context Menu
form:FormGroup.helpText: What a right-click in a text field or code editor shows. Stroom shows Stroom's own menu (Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All and so on), styled as Stroom's other menus. Browser shows your browser's menu, with its spelling suggestions and password manager. A Shift+right-click always shows the browser's menu. Default is Stroom unless an administrator has changed the defaults.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stroom or Browser. Shift+right-click always shows the browser's menu.
